card.name: Bombing and terrorism news passages
card.fires_on: Words in news or reading-comprehension text about bomb attacks, suicide bombers and terrorism, such as 'in' after 'bus', 'suicide' and 'a' before 'bomber'. It also fires weakly on scattered words in security and trafficking text.
